meta.scope: Market average and market cap price per sponsored deliverable, KSA / UAE / Egypt, 2025-2026

fx.egp_note: Interbank ~49.9 on 10 Aug 2026 [S23]; 2025 average ~50 (same band used for T17); Valors Aug 2026 quotes USD and EGP at ~50. All EGP sources converted at 50. SAR/EGP = 0.075; current approx unchanged.

definitions.low: bottom of the common range, not a bargain outlier
definitions.average: typical price an agency should expect to pay the CREATOR (creator-side fee) for one organic deliverable under standard usage; sits between transacted contracts (where they exist) and the middle of asking bands
definitions.cap: top of the common asking range after removing vendor outliers; above this a client is overpaying unless it buys exclusivity, paid usage, or a celebrity premium

meta.confidence_legend: high = 10+ independent asking figures AND contract-level data; medium = 4+ independent figures that agree within ~3x; low = <4 figures, large conflicts, or extrapolated
meta.extrapolation_rule: is_extrapolation=true means no direct published figure; value derived from the Instagram row via a documented ratio
meta.agency_note: All figures are CREATOR-SIDE fees. Client price = creator fee x1.18-1.43 (typically x1.25-1.30) before production, usage, boosting.

instagram.unit: per sponsored Reel/feed post (organic, standard usage, creator-side fee)

nano.basis: triangulated from published ranges (+ transacted contracts where noted)
nano.rationale: Vendor bands span 200-3,000 (median low ~245, median high ~1,500, 7 figures); marketplace listings SAR 190-450. Avg ~0.6x asking midpoint; cap = median of vendor highs.

micro.basis: triangulated from published ranges (+ transacted contracts where noted)
micro.rationale: 8 vendor bands: median low ~1,360, median high ~7,400. A named Saudi TikTok creator at 45K followers asks 2,500-3,000 [T1]. No KSA contract data; avg ~0.7x asking midpoint (UAE contracts show 0.3-0.6x but skew to expat product-swap deals).

mid.basis: triangulated from published ranges (+ transacted contracts where noted)
mid.rationale: 7 vendor bands: median low ~7,500, median high ~30,000. Named-creator list prices 1M+ accounts at only 22-31K [T1], so vendor highs of 75K for 100K-1M are not credible for the 100-500K band. Cap 25,000 (Hovi/Elev8or top end).

macro.basis: triangulated from published ranges (+ transacted contracts where noted)
macro.rationale: Vendor bands 24,000-100,000 (Starngage up to 100K). Named 1-1.6M-follower accounts ask 22-31K (one at 6-7K) [T1]. Avg 25,000; cap 55,000 (Elev8or health top 58,500, below Hovi 75,000).

mega.basis: triangulated from published ranges (+ transacted contracts where noted)
mega.rationale: CONFLICT: vendors 75K to 500K+ vs named-creator list 19-31K for 1.4-5.8M followers [T1] and modelled Scrumball SAR ~17-27K at 3M TikTok followers [T28]. Avg/cap are a triangulation, low confidence.

instagram.unit: per sponsored Reel/feed post (organic, standard usage, creator-side fee)

nano.basis: triangulated from published ranges (+ transacted contracts where noted)
nano.rationale: 12 asking figures: median low ~400, median high ~2,000; Yamammi contracts median 500 (100-800, n=40). Avg 600 sits just above transacted median; cap 1,500 (top of common band).

micro.basis: triangulated from published ranges (+ transacted contracts where noted)
micro.rationale: 12 asking bands: median low 1,500, median high ~6,500. Contracts: median 1,000 (800-2,500, n=190 of 350). Avg 2,000 balances contracts (skewed to product-for-post expat creators) and ~0.5x asking midpoint; cap 6,500 = median asking high.

mid.basis: triangulated from published ranges (+ transacted contracts where noted)
mid.rationale: 10 asking bands: median low ~7,500, median high ~30,000 (100K-1M bands inflate highs). Contracts 50-250K: median 2,000 (1,000-4,500, n=80). Avg 6,000 and cap 25,000 chosen between the two; contract gap is 3-4x.

macro.basis: triangulated from published ranges (+ transacted contracts where noted)
macro.rationale: Asking: lows 9-35K, highs 25-100K. Contracts 250K-1M median 2,500 (n=30) look like small-ticket deals; ignored for avg but kept as low. Avg 15,000 = ~0.6x asking midpoint; cap 45,000.

mega.basis: triangulated from published ranges (+ transacted contracts where noted)
mega.rationale: Asking 50K-250K+, celebrity 75K-250K. Contracts n=10 median 10,000 (5-20K). Avg 35,000 weights both; cap 120,000. Low confidence (6 figures, thin n).

reference.title: Market prices per sponsored post, KSA / UAE / Egypt
reference.note: Creator-side fee for one organic deliverable under standard usage, ex-VAT, ex-agency fee. Asking prices and vendor estimates, not audited market data.
how_to_read: Low / Average / Cap: the bottom of the common range, the typical creator fee an agency should expect to pay, and the top of the common asking range.
Client price is roughly creator fee x 1.27 (range 1.18 to 1.43) before production, usage and boosting.
Confidence: high = 10+ independent asking figures and contract-level data; medium = 4+ figures that agree within about 3x; low = fewer than 4, large conflicts, or extrapolated.
A row marked extrapolation has no direct published figure; it is derived from the Instagram row by a documented ratio.
caveats: Every price is a vendor or agency estimate. None comes from an audited market sample.
There is no KSA or Egypt contract dataset. The only transacted data is one UAE agency (350 signed contracts, Aug 2025 to Aug 2026), unaudited and skewed to product-for-post micro creators.

Asking prices are far above what is paid: UAE contracts sit at about 0.3x the rate-card midpoint at micro and 0.15 to 0.25x at mid and macro. Use contracts or averages for budgeting, rate cards only for the cap.
Only UAE Instagram micro has high confidence. KSA macro and mega are triangulations between conflicting sources. TikTok, Snapchat and YouTube rows are mostly extrapolations.
Several vendors re-publish one another (IMH quotes Starngage; Keepface quotes IMH and Miqwal; Elev8or uses one USD formula for all three markets). They are counted once.
Healthcare and HCP premiums come from one modelled vendor table and one US vendor. SFDA and Mawthooq rules are from law-firm summaries and need checking against the original text.

method: Collected every figure per cell, normalised to a per-deliverable creator fee, dropped package and monthly prices, and removed vendors that re-publish one another.
Low = median of asking-band lows (or the transacted low if lower). Cap = median of asking-band highs after removing blended 100K to 1M bands for mid.

Average = between the transacted median (where one exists) and about 0.5 to 0.7x the asking midpoint; for KSA and Egypt, with no contracts, 0.6 to 0.75x the asking midpoint, cross-checked against named-creator asks and marketplace listings.
Platforms other than Instagram are labelled extrapolations unless 3 or more direct sources exist.
